description: This Java class defines the ProductReviewDescription entity, which models a localized description associated with a product review in an e-commerce system. It extends the Description class and includes a reference to the ProductReview entity. The class is annotated for persistence with JPA annotations, mapping to the PRODUCT_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION table with a unique constraint on PRODUCT_REVIEW_ID and LANGUAGE_ID.
